system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

exchanges.user:
ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**Buyer review — Project Kestrel.** The Seller Update describes proposed positions, not agreed terms. No written authority from Amelia Frost has been given for either the 20% general cap or the 18-month claims period.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 — General liability cap** | 20% / AUD 4.8m. | 25% / AUD 6m for general Warranty Claims. | **Reject 20%.** It is an approval-only fallback, and no draft-specific written approval exists. |
| **SPA-N-002 — De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 per claim; AUD 250,000 deductible basket. | AUD 5,000 de minimis; AUD 50,000 aggregate basket, recoverable from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Counter with playbook thresholds.** The Seller’s terms materially reduce recovery for smaller claims. |
| **SPA-N-003 — General claims time limit** | Notice within 18 months; default extension of limitations to all Claims. | 24 months for general Warranty Claims only. | **Reject both changes.** Eighteen months requires unprovided written approval, and other claim categories need their own rules. |
| **SPA-N-004 — Fundamental/Title regime** | Same cap and period as general warranties. | Separate 100% cap, at least six years, with no general basket, de minimis or knowledge bar. | **Reject.** Ownership and capacity risk must not be compressed into the general regime. |
| **SPA-N-005 — Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to all Claims. | Carve fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct out of all caps, thresholds, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insist; do not waive.** The Seller’s “all Claims” language would undermine the mandatory carve-out. |
| **SPA-N-006 — Disclosure scope** | Whole data room, Accounts, registers and public records generally disclosed. | Specific, fair disclosure against the relevant warranty. | **Delete deemed general disclosure.** Mere availability or searchability does not fairly identify the nature and scope of an exception. |
| **SPA-N-007 — Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Bars matters known to Buyer or advisers, including discoverable matters. | Delete the blanket bar; any seller-knowledge wording must name persons and require reasonable enquiry, without excusing title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities. | **Reject.** Constructive buyer knowledge would transfer the Seller’s warranty risk to Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-008 — Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent treated as satisfied upon delivery. The letter confirms no final consent or evidence of satisfied conditions. | Effective written consent **and evidence that clause 11.3 conditions are satisfied before Completion**. | **Make this a firm completion condition.** Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue. |
| **SPA-N-009 — Riverlark facility** | About AUD 3.2m outstanding; security release after Completion. | Current payout figure, direct repayment from Completion funds and effective releases at Completion. | **Reject an unsecured post-Completion release.** Any exception needs an irrevocable undertaking and Amelia Frost’s approval. |
| **SPA-N-010 — Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional bonuses omitted from funds flow; on-costs unstated. | Specific funds-flow line item or Seller funding for triggered bonuses and applicable on-costs. | **Revise funds flow before signing.** The debt-free/cash-free economics must not silently shift this cost to Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-011 — Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity confined to SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 shown open. | Broader protection for payment, ownership, transfer and related loss, while preserving the SOW3 payment/assignment cure. | **Expand and verify.** DD-010 is not independent proof of payment or non-payment, and no receipt or confirmatory assignment is supplied. |
| **SPA-N-012 — Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary and not expected to be material. | Preserve logs, investigate scope and access, provide updates, and address remediation and any notification duty on evidence. | **Keep an active investigation covenant.** Do not assume a confirmed breach, harm, notification obligation or loss amount. |
| **SPA-N-013 — Sandbar renewals** | AUD 330,000 aggregate ordinary-course costs. | Assess timing, scope, accrual, termination rights and whether the costs are unavoidable. | **Reserve treatment pending diligence.** Neither automatic Debt classification nor an automatic price deduction is justified. |
| **SPA-N-014 — Category separation** | General limitations proposed to apply to all Claims unless expressly excluded. | Separate Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant regimes, with no hidden general-regime override. | **Rework cross-references and definitions.** A broad “all Claims” provision could nullify category-specific protections. |
| **SPA-N-015 — Title verification** | Relies on the DD-012 company share register. | Independent ownership, encumbrance and authority evidence. | **Require verification before Completion.** An internally supplied register is a starting source, not independent proof of clear title. |
| **SPA-N-016 — Tax/IP open terms** | Says Tax and IP warranties are settled under the general regime. | Keep Tax and IP terms expressly open for separate negotiation. | **Reject the asserted settlement.** No unlimited liability or final Tax/IP position has been agreed. |
=== END ADVICE ===
